items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: you’re playing with Ed Thigpen and Ron — a guitar player Ron? ... Ron Eschete. ... And you’re playing “Oleo.”

ctx.x: Play for your supper. I mentioned Jimmy Wormworth because he’s from Utica where I am, and he is a well known local figure. I found on the internet the video, and I wonder if you remember this, it came from 1987 from the Guitar Institute and you’re playing with Ed Thigpen and Ron — a guitar player Ron?

Eschete. And you’re playing “Oleo.” And this thing was so fast that I got out an on-line metronome and I tried to figure out the tempo. And it’s so fast that it was off the chart. And I had to figure out okay what are the beats per minute of the half note. And this thing was like 320 beats per minute. Do you remember this?
